description: NLI publication-gate packs (VER-R2). The NLI auditor checks every justification sentence against its cited span BEFORE publication (VERIFICATION §2.7). Must-pass pack: sentences fully entailed. Must-fail packs cover the known hallucination classes: unattributed synthesis, unstated arithmetic, authority-by-citation, hallucinated content. The auditor is itself an LLM — mocked at L1; these packs pin the gate CONTRACT.

mustPass.justification: Police-recorded victimisations rose from 328,000 in 2017 to 366,400 in 2026, an increase of about 11.6%.
On a per-capita basis the increase from 2017 to 2026 is about 1.9%, reflecting population growth over the period.

mustFail.justification: Experts agree crime is out of control.
The data shows crime nearly doubled since 2017.
According to Statistics New Zealand, crime rose 30%.
mustFail.citedSpan: Press release: crime is up 30 percent

mustFail.justification: The series shows crime fell in 2018, contradicting the claim.
